breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction. The incomplete prompt specified a counterflow exchanger but provided the temperature difference equations for a parallel-flow exchanger. The agent corrected this by defining the temperature differences according to the counterflow configuration, as specified in the ground truth (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in).
